subject: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Approval
overview: The City Council approved the Fiscal Year 2026 budget and several free cash appropriations for school infrastructure, tree planting, and urban planning studies. The Council also passed a resolution requiring the Police Department to provide weekly reports on federal immigration enforcement activity within the city.

items.title: Minutes and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the records of the May 27 regular meeting and committee reports regarding the city budget, zoning corridors, facility maintenance, and public engagement initiatives.

items.title: Resolution on Resident Technology Access
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee to brainstorm ways to provide City Hall resources to residents lacking internet or computer access.

items.title: Public Hearings for Special Permits and Zoning
items.summary: Continued a hearing regarding a Mystic Avenue signboard permit and a hearing on residential district zoning amendments to the next regular meeting.

items.title: Grants of Location for Utility Poles
items.summary: Approved three petitions from National Grid to replace and install utility poles and conduits on Fulton Street and Main Street with engineering department conditions.

items.title: Resolution on ICE Operations Transparency
items.summary: Approved a resolution as amended requiring the Police Department to deliver weekly written reports and regular presentations on Immigration and Customs Enforcement activities in Medford. The Council debated the balance between public safety and the need to counter community fear with factual information.

items.title: Resolution on Federal Military Deployment in Los Angeles
items.summary: Approved a resolution condemning the deployment of federal military forces in Los Angeles and standing in solidarity with residents exercising their right to protest.

items.title: Heavy Trucking and Quincy Street Resolutions
items.summary: Tabled a discussion on Quincy Street issues and referred a resolution to the Public Works and Facilities Committee to explore commercial vehicle exclusions on neighborhood streets.

items.title: FY2026 Budget Approval
items.summary: Approved the amended Fiscal Year 2026 General Fund budget of $205,852,504 following a discussion on free cash reserves and a $550 million backlog of capital needs. The administration committed to presenting a comprehensive capital investment plan by the end of the summer.

items.title: Free Cash and Retained Earnings Appropriations
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of over $2.1 million from free cash for stabilization funds, school technology, and zoning studies, along with $462,000 in water and sewer retained earnings for infrastructure repairs.

items.title: Ordinances: Flood and Parking Amendments
items.summary: Passed amendments to the flood ordinance and ordained changes to the parking ordinance through their final readings.
